description: Where in the world a crop (or one variety) suits the climate: land area that fits well, the best regions and countries, the best-fitting towns, and what stops it elsewhere. Scored on a 0.125° land grid. Climate only.

crop.description: Crop slug from list_crops, e.g. avocado

variety.description: Variety slug from list_crops. Default: the best variety at each place

name: where_to_grow
title: Where a crop grows best
